purpose: A single pre-MFA pronunciation source of truth shared by search tables, MFA lexicon generation, TextGrid provenance, and six-year methods reporting.

variant_policy.canonical_table_unit: one observed surface type with a JSON list of zero or more explicitly selected variants
variant_policy.morphologically_conditioned_variants: retain explicit morphology evidence; use multiple variants or a separately adopted occurrence-key remap rather than silently collapsing distinct readings

selection_policy: Preserve an r2 phone sequence only when its model-group Roman sequence agrees with the mandatory surface-rule reference.
Audit observed base-dictionary entries under the same rule; base-dictionary membership is not automatic approval.
Use dictionary-attested pronunciations as independent evidence, not as realized-speech truth.
Use morphology and POS to resolve lexical candidates where an inflected eojeol cannot be matched as a plain dictionary headword.
Do not activate optional rules, cross-eojeol sandhi, n-insertion, or unresolved l-nasalization as a single truth without an explicit status.
Do not feed a respelled Hangul form to Jamo G2P and accept arbitrary 1-best output; candidate phones must map exactly to the selected Roman target or remain unresolved.
Never repair a completed TextGrid by relabeling phone intervals in place; accepted r3 pronunciations require re-alignment.
adoption_gates: all observed tokens represented exactly once
all selected phones inside the frozen acoustic inventory
emitted MFA dictionary is byte-equivalent to the canonical selected-phone projection
every retained rule-sensitive mismatch has an explicit reason and decision id
2022 reviewed regression IDs 08, 09, 15, and 24 pass the intended boundary and label checks
stratified automatic regression covers neutralization, fortition, nasal assimilation, liaison, aspiration, h-deletion, palatalization, and cluster simplification
one r3 contract id is pinned by every annual alignment contract
every annual TextGrid and companion-table manifest pins the same r3 contract id and MFA dictionary SHA
changed pronunciation sessions export phones_mfa from an r3-aligned DB rather than relabeling r2 intervals
unchanged sessions are reused only after exact r2-r3 token-variant equivalence and alignment-unit provenance are proved
phoneme_r_auto is regenerated or verified deterministically against the final phones_mfa tier

output_policy.phones_mfa: time-aligned phones from the selected r3 MFA input pronunciation; not realized-speech truth
output_policy.phoneme_r_auto: deterministic broad Roman mapping of phones_mfa; never a correction layer
output_policy.search_tables: retain orthographic Roman, rule reference, dictionary candidates, selected backend phones, and provenance as separate columns
output_policy.textgrid_tier_count: no automatic tier increase is required for r3; detailed provenance remains in companion CSV tables

textgrid_materialization_gate.source_of_words_and_phones: either a new MFA database aligned with r3 or an existing r2 interval set proven pronunciation-equivalent for the complete MFA adaptation unit
textgrid_materialization_gate.completion_rule: an annual result is not complete until every utterance resolves through a final index to either a verified-equivalent retained TextGrid or an r3-realigned TextGrid, and all companion tables pass the same-contract audit

rerun_policy.required_after_adoption: build exact impact inventory; realign changed MFA adaptation units only for 2020-2022; align 2023-2025 once with r3
unchanged_reuse_requirements: every LAB token in the complete MFA adaptation unit has an identical ordered pronunciation-variant set in r2 and r3
WAV and LAB fingerprints, acoustic model, feature configuration, and alignment settings are unchanged
the retained TextGrid and source DB passed the prior production audit
a stratified sample of equivalent units is rerun with r3 and passes label and boundary equivalence tolerance
a final utterance index records the retained source path and equivalence proof SHA
rerun_policy.changed_unit_scope: realign the complete MFA speaker/session adaptation unit when any token pronunciation variant changes
